entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A sylvok scout outcast immune to phyresis, with healing powers; a Mirran resistance figure who died at the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: The last troll, who raised Melira.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who grew protective of Melira.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Planeswalker who leads the resistance with Melira.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Planeswalker who gave his immunity to Karn at the cost of his life.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Phyrexian who held Melira and offered her as a gift.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: Leader of a rebel camp in the furnace layer.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Golem corrupted by Phyrexian oil and cured by Venser.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Phyrexian who led a group that broke through the tunnel.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who perfected the glistening oil.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Infected planeswalker on the strike team.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Helped by Melira to reach Realmbreaker and merge with it.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: Planeswalker Melira tried to help reach Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Compleated planeswalker who impaled Melira, later un-compleated.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Compleated planeswalker un-compleated with Melira's help.

entities.name: Mirrodin

events.summary: Melira is rescued as an infant by Thrun after being abandoned in the Tangle.
events.quote: She was rescued by Thrun , the last troll, who cared for her.

events.summary: Elspeth, Koth and Venser free Melira from Tezzeret.
events.quote: Melira was freed by Elspeth Tirel , Koth , and Venser from Tezzeret 's clutches

events.summary: Melira heals everyone in Ezuri's camp infected by the oil.
events.quote: She healed all those in the camp who were infected by the oil

events.summary: Venser gives his immunity to Karn, curing him at the cost of his life.
events.quote: Venser gave his immunity to Karn, curing the golem at the cost of his life.

events.summary: Melira joins the planeswalker strike team to attack Elesh Norn.
events.quote: She offered to heal any wounds, but the infected Nahiri declined.

events.summary: Nissa Revane impales Melira, who heals Wrenn so she can merge with Realmbreaker.
events.quote: She healed Wrenn enough to help her merge with Realmbreaker before collapsing.

events.summary: Melira dies helping to un-compleat Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane.
events.quote: she used the last of her strength to help un-compleat both Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane .

relations.quote: She was rescued by Thrun , the last troll, who cared for her.
Elspeth grew very close to and protective of Melira.
Karn asked Koth to begin organizing and leading the resistance with Melira
Melira was impaled in the stomach by a barbed vine from the compleated planeswalker Nissa Revane
